name: megascenes-wedding-photoshoot
description: Create pre-wedding and wedding photos of the two of you from your own photos in your MegaScenes library: the same faces on a beach at sunset, in a vineyard or in a city at night.

interface.longDescription:
Pick one photo of the two of you, or one photo of each, from your MegaScenes library and choose the setting, the outfits and the style: a vineyard at golden hour, a beach at sunset, a Paris street at night, a garden with an arch of flowers, in a wedding dress and suit or casual linen, romantic editorial, candid film or black and white. You get a picture that keeps both faces, in the scene you chose.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the picture needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The picture opens in the chat and stays in your library next to your photos.

For save the dates, wedding websites, invitations and albums.

Limitations: only the couple from your own photos, with the consent of both, never a famous person; no swimwear, underwear or sensual shots. One or two photos, already in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Place the two of you in a wedding scene
Return the photo in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a pre-wedding photo of us in a vineyard at golden hour from my latest MegaScenes photo
Put the two of us on a beach at sunset in a white dress and a navy suit
Create a black and white photo of us on a Paris street at night

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a pre-wedding photo of the two of us in a vineyard at golden hour from the couple photo in my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one wedding photo needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a wedding photoshoot here?
positive.expected_behavior: The wedding photoshoot models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a photo of the two of us on a beach at sunset in a white lace dress and a navy suit from the couple photo in my MegaScenes library. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my wedding photo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my wedding photo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
